facts.fact: A working group led by the Annir Initiative with Internet Society Libya published an informal draft Personal Data Protection Law for public consultation, marked unofficial and not a government bill; its published date is used as no other is given.
facts.system: Draft Personal Data Protection Law (law no. ___ of 2026)

facts.fact: In March 2026 a civil-society consultation draft of a Libyan personal data protection law was published; the document does not say the government has taken it up.
facts.system: Draft Personal Data Protection Law (law no. ___ of 2026)
